The table lists the estimated energy density improvements for different technologies. To find the largest improvement, we can compare the values in the "Estimated Energy Density Improvement (Wh/kg)" column.

The values in the column are:
- 225-250 Wh/kg (Section 4 – Water-Based Processing of Cathodes (i.e. NMC 532))
- 250-275 Wh/kg (Section 5 – Water-Based Processing of Si/C Anodes (N:P ¼ 1.1))
- 275-300 Wh/kg (Section 6 – Low-Co/Ni-Rich Cathodes (i.e. NMC 811))
- 250-275 Wh/kg (Section 7 – Co-Free NFA)
- 220-240^a (Section 8 – Coating Parameter and Drying Protocols)
- 325-350^b (Section 9 – Ultra-High-Speed (Thick) Electrode Processing (Uncalendered))
- 260-280^a,b (Section 10 – Ultra-Fast Formation Cycling)

The largest estimated energy density improvement is 325-350 Wh/kg, which is associated with Section 9 – Ultra-High-Speed (Thick) Electrode Processing (Uncalendered).
